name: San Francisco
local_rules: San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency handles all parking citation appeals. First-level protest (Administrative Review) must be submitted within 21 days of ticket issue date. Mail to: San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency Customer Service Center, ATTN: Citation Review, 11 South Van Ness Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94103.

mail_acceptance_policy.official_excerpt: You may contest a parking citation by mail to SFMTA Customer Service Center, ATTN: Citation Review, 11 South Van Ness Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94103 within 21 days of the citation issue date or first courtesy notice. Online contest also available at sfmta.com/contest.

confirmation_note: San Francisco gives you 21 days from the notice to contest. After that, the city may add late fees or automatically enter a default judgment. San Francisco offers an online dispute portal. You can check the official city site for the most up-to-date contest instructions before mailing.
